title: 국유재산법 제80조에 따른 청산절차의 특례에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00093:20090731:00019:part:1/1
title_original: 국유재산법 제80조에 따른 청산절차의 특례에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the State Property Act) <Rule No. 93, July 31, 2009>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on July 31, 2009: Provided, That among the amended provisions of Article 5 (2) of these Addenda, the part changing the name of Korea Land Corporation to Korea Land and Housing Corporation shall enter into force on October 1, 2009.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) The Rules on Special Cases concerning Liquidation Procedures under Article 55 of the State Property Act shall be partially amended as follows:

The title "Rules on Special Cases concerning Liquidation Procedures under Article 55 of the State Property Act" shall be replaced with "Rules on Special Cases concerning Liquidation Procedures under Article 80 of the State Property Act".

In Article 1, "designation of corporations subject to special cases concerning liquidation pursuant to Article 55 of the State Property Act and Article 60 of the Enforcement Decree of the State Property Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'Decree'), and operation of the Joint Liquidation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the 'Committee') under Article 61 (6) of the Decree" shall be replaced with "designation of corporations subject to special cases concerning liquidation under Article 80 of the State Property Act and Article 79 of the Enforcement Decree thereof".

In the part of Article 2 preceding its subparagraphs, "pursuant to Article 60 of the Decree" shall be replaced with "pursuant to Article 79 of the Enforcement Decree of the State Property Act".

Articles 3 through 7 shall be deleted, respectively.

(4) Omitted.

Article 6
Omitted.
